verdict.rationale: Unity documents first-party programmatic surfaces that work as official SDKs: public scripting APIs, editor-extension APIs, Package Manager packages such as the multiplayer packages, and the Sentis inference library, with a keyless UPM registry probe confirming the packages resolve. The evidence is only one-line snippets, with no explicit SDK catalogue or language or service client libraries. The core engine docs at docs.unity3d.com are not machine-readable (no llms.txt or .md mirrors), which limits AI-native consumption. Missing for 10: an explicit official SDK listing with language and service coverage, in-depth API reference evidence, machine-readable engine docs, and independent hands-on corroboration of building against the SDKs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Interacting directly with the public Unity APIs allows for finer control and a greater degree of customization.
Packages deliver a wide range of enhancements to Unity through the Package Manager.
Sentis is a neural network inference library for Unity.
Simplify multiplayer game creation with Unity’s multiplayer packages and services.
